research_question: RQ-D: does the near-zero shap_sum-vs-matched-control effect and the small select_shap-vs-select_random effect survive once the 54 static metrics are reduced to one representative per correlated cluster?
status: FROZEN before execution. This file, and the cluster/VIF inputs it derives from, were committed to the repository before experiment_decorrelation.py exists. Any script implementing this analysis must reproduce reduced_features exactly from clusters.csv and vif.csv as specified below; if it does not, that is a deviation and must be disclosed, not silently corrected.

inputs.note: Both files were produced by strengthened.diagnostic_correlation before this protocol was written, from the pooled 7-project static metrics only. Neither touches RealBug.

representative_selection_rule: Within each cluster_0.7 group, sort members by (vif ascending, feature name ascending) and take the first. Deterministic, no randomness, ties broken alphabetically. This is a single fixed rule chosen before any decorrelated-arm result exists; it is not re-derived or adjusted after execution.
arms_not_rerun: All other v3 arms (p_aug, ps_aug, pn_aug, pr_aug, coral, prevalence, permuted_original) are out of scope for this sensitivity and are not rerun on the reduced feature set.

grid.note: Everything else identical to protocol_v3.json. Only the feature list is reduced.

aggregation: Identical to v3: average repeats, teachers and learners within target, then equal-target mean. Leave-one-target-out aggregation sensitivity reported for both new comparisons.

predeclared_thresholds.basis: Derived from the already-completed v3 main run (outputs/revised/strengthening_v3/full/summary.csv), before this sensitivity is executed. Using prior completed results to set a threshold for a new prospective test is standard practice; the numbers below are fixed now and are not revisited after the decorrelated arms are run.
predeclared_thresholds.conclusion_unchanged_if: mean_difference for shap_sum-vs-uniform_sum, shap_sum-vs-shuffled_sum and select_shap-vs-select_random on the reduced feature set stays below 0.02 ROC-AUC in absolute value (roughly 2x the widest single-target excursion already observed on the full feature set) AND does not change sign relative to the v3 main-run value for the same comparison.
predeclared_thresholds.conclusion_flagged_as_decorrelation_sens: any of the three comparisons exceeds 0.02 ROC-AUC in absolute value, or changes sign.
predeclared_thresholds.select_shap_specific_check: select_shap-vs-select_random on the reduced feature set is additionally compared against the already-established synthetic zero-signal offset of 0.006056: if the decorrelated real-data effect remains at or below that offset, the zero-signal-bias explanation for the original 54-feature result is considered to extend to the decorrelated case; if it clearly exceeds 0.006056, that extension is not supported and must be reported as such.

what_this_would_show: If the small effects persist essentially unchanged after decorrelation, the correlation-cluster/dilution mechanism identified by strengthened.diagnostic_correlation is not the (sole) explanation for shap_sum and select_shap being near-zero on the 54-feature set, and the null must be attributed to something else. If the effects change substantially, collinearity was a material contributor and the 54-feature result should not be read as evidence against attribution utility in general, only against attribution utility under uncontrolled collinearity.
inference: Descriptive fixed-benchmark effect, matching v3. No significance test, confidence interval or equivalence bound. Target rotations share source projects.
